explanation: This lemma is a simp evaluation lemma for `TauCeti.invariantColouringEquiv`, an equivalence the library defines itself. It identifies colourings of the cycles of π with π-invariant colourings. The statement only unfolds the definition's `invFun`, which is `Quotient.lift`, at a point `Quotient.mk _ a`. The proof uses only the generic `Equiv.apply_symm_apply` together with `congrArg` and `congrFun`. All of the mathematical content is in the library's own definition. I did not look for a Mathlib equivalence of this kind (from functions on the cycle quotient `SameCycle.setoid π` to invariant functions) whose symm-apply lemma could be cited. The lemma's content is purely definitional, so there is no Mathlib declaration it could duplicate.
